newsitem.title: USA: ScanSource files for 2 mln common shares.
newsitem.headline: ScanSource files for 2 mln common shares.

text.p: ScanSource Inc said Thursday it filed a registration with Securities and Echange Commission to sell up to two million common shares.

The underwriters were granted a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 300,000 additional common shares. The offering will be made through Robertson, Stephens & Co, The Robinson-Humphrey Co Inc and William Blair & Co.
After the offering, outstanding shares will total 5,247,986 common, according to the filing.
Proceeds will be used to repay bank debt and for general corporate purposes, including working capital and possible acquisitions, the company said.
ScanSource, based in Greenville, S.C., is a value-added wholesaler distributor of speciality technology products exclusively to resellers.
